description: Asks a person at Portaur to telephone the person you are helping. Needs their name, email address, phone number and the reason for the call; a preferred time window is optional. Use it only when the person asked to be called. It stores the request in Portaur's inbox and sends one email to the address given, asking the person to confirm; Portaur's phone is alerted only after they do. A person makes the call by hand: nothing ever dials or texts the number. Returns a handle for request_status. It never sends anything to anyone else and never quotes a price.

email.description: Their email address. Portaur sends one confirmation email here.

name.description: The name of the person who wants a call.

phone.description: The number to call: 7 to 15 digits, with spaces and + ( ) . allowed.

window.description: When they would like the call, with their time zone. Optional.

name: request_callback
title: Ask Portaur to call back
